defect_observations.observation: The remark that the one-sided cones 'impose no requirement that every coordinate have the same sign' is regime-dependent: the cap {d^T u>c_+} lies inside the open same-sign orthant of x-m1 iff c_+>=sqrt((n-1)/n), i.e. iff t_{nu,alpha}>=nu.
